tests.notes: The existing integrated regression is materially sufficient and no extra test file was added: it directly asserts relative/hidden field containment, nonzero capped geometry, absolute canvas/fallback containment, four in-bounds absolute labels, document overflow, visible hero copy, How it works and Pricing navigation, and Workspace access routing to the role gateway at both required viewports. Independent full-page inspection showed a coherent desktop two-column hero and readable single-column mobile layout without scattered raw labels. No test was skipped, marked flaky, retried, or hidden. Live Railway deployment state and /health verification are deployment/orchestrator evidence and were not exercised by this local tester run.
